test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 

His autobiography will be one of the most ______ awaited books.
solution:
"The correct answer is option 1) eagerly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**- The word "awaited" suggests that people are looking forward to the release of the book.

- The word "eagerly" means with enthusiasm or excitement, which fits the context of the sentence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**- The word "deftly" means skillfully or cleverly, which does not make sense in this context.

- The word "badly" means poorly or inadequately, which is the opposite of what is suggested in the sentence.

- The word "slowly" means at a slow pace, which does not fit the context of people eagerly anticipating the book's release."
